context: M3 o5. Herald Square. Ptl. Navarro steps off the curb and waves the cab down.

lines.speaker: char.luis_navarro
lines.text: Teddy? In a cab? You can't drive a cab, you don't have a hack license.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I'm parking it, Luis. Very slowly.

lines.speaker: char.luis_navarro
lines.text: You taught me never take the coffee, Teddy. I don't even drink coffee now.

lines.speaker: char.luis_navarro
lines.text: Paperwork is a weapon. Everybody forgets that but me.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: You'll make detective, kid. Wave me through before Sarge sees.

lines.speaker: char.luis_navarro
lines.text: Go. And get a license. I'm serious. I'll check.
